device.model: HD X7 Combo (System ID 06000200, Synaps Galaxy / UPC 1.5.24 VI build)
device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T / Twin Full HD satellite & terrestrial combo receiver with VFD, 2x CA, 2x CI
device.board: 06000200 (Globo / Opticum M3602A "Lemontree" VFD platform with EuP standby MCU)
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0 / SCB1 at I2C 0x33 (+ COFDM DVB-T probe at I2C 0x11)
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB0 / SCB1 at I2C 0x60

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Opticum / Globo firmware archive)
source.author: Globo / Opticum / Synaps
source.note: Archive Opticum_HD_x7_galaxy_UPC_synaps_1.5.24.VI.rar from the Opticum / Opticum HD X402-X403-X4-X7 directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-10-31.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602A board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_x7_app_starts.py, run_dump_x7_capture_screen.py): the "M3602A 1.1.6" bootloader prints "APP  init ok", exchanges CRC-16/XMODEM transactions and two 38-byte PT6311 8-character 14-segment VFD frames (op 0x33: "  BOOT  " -> "        ") with the external Lemontree EuP standby and VFD microcontroller at I2C 0x28 over bit-banged GPIO 62 (SCL) / 171 (SDA), unpacks the 7.3 MB maincode(AV) to 0x80008000 and enters the application.  The application programmes its IR wake codes on the Lemontree MCU, updates the 8-character PT6311 VFD to "   ON   ", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB0 and SCB1, and renders its 1280x720 Synaps OSD dialog through GeM3602 (8 GE commands, 30 unique colours; without the board's anti-clone security IC at I2C 0x65 it shows "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW! ----00000000000000 06000200").

desc: Opticum HD X7 Combo (System ID 06000200) firmware 1.5.24.VI with the Synaps Galaxy / UPC GUI (2012-03-18) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602A Full HD combo/twin receiver with 2x CA and 2x CI.

Drives an 8-character 14-segment PT6311 VFD display ("  BOOT  " -> "   ON   ") through the external Lemontree EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 using 38-byte op-0x33 CRC-16/XMODEM frames, alongside ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator(s) at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner(s) at I2C 0x60.
